fields.statement: At bc8cc09ca: go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... exit 0 (TestPlanBuiltin and TestPlanPromptsOneLine assert plan.toml and plan-milestone.toml interview/review/critic/revise prompts equal the four one-liners, contain no 'session done', and prepush-fix keeps its own text); go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(plan-|bugfix-workflow-autonomous|arbiter-agent-tabs|status|guide|describe-golden)' exit 0 with fake agents matching /rhiza-planner, /rhiza-plan-reviewer, /rhiza-plan-critic, /rhiza-plan-reviser; describe-golden unchanged (prompts not in describe output). Diff reviewed: only the four prompts in each builtin, the tests, the scripts and the builder's actor record changed; prepush-fix untouched; session-done rules present in planner/plan-reviewer/plan-critic/plan-reviser topics; no TODOs. make self-check: every check passes except render of this verifier's own untracked actor record (claude-code-bfbb34bc, not part of the commit); rhiza render on a clean detached checkout of HEAD writes no diff.
